events.title: British East India Company Chartered
events.description: Queen Elizabeth I granted a royal charter to the Governor and Company of Merchants of London Trading into the East Indies, giving it a monopoly on English trade with Asia.
events.significance: The company grew from a trading enterprise into a ruling power that controlled much of the Indian subcontinent, shaping the course of British imperialism and global trade.

events.title: England Imposes the Window Tax
events.description: A window tax took effect in England and Wales under William III, assessing houses based on the number of windows they had to raise revenue after the Great Recoinage.
events.significance: The tax is a well-known example of property-based taxation and influenced architecture, as many windows were bricked up to avoid payment. It remained in force until 1851.

events.title: Edison Demonstrates Incandescent Lighting
events.description: Thomas Edison gave the first public demonstration of his incandescent electric light bulb at Menlo Park, New Jersey, lighting up the area for visitors.
events.significance: The demonstration helped pave the way for commercial electric lighting and the development of electric power systems that transformed daily life and industry.

events.title: Boris Yeltsin Resigns as President of Russia
events.description: Boris Yeltsin unexpectedly announced his resignation, naming Prime Minister Vladimir Putin as acting president. He apologized to the Russian people for the unfulfilled hopes of the post-Soviet transition.
events.significance: The resignation marked a major turning point in Russian politics, beginning the era of Vladimir Putin's dominance in Russian leadership.

events.title: United States Transfers Control of the Panama Canal
events.description: In accordance with the Torrijos-Carter Treaties of 1977, the United States handed full control of the Panama Canal and the surrounding Canal Zone to Panama.
events.significance: The handover ended nearly a century of American control over the strategic waterway and was a significant moment for Panamanian sovereignty.
